name: smwgraphics-classic-wham-bam-ruins
title: Classic Wham Bam Ruins
description:
Despite the name, this tileset draws most of its inspiration from Sonic 1's Labyrinth Zone. The Wham Bam part comes from the Wham Bam Rock graphic on one of the setpieces. This set requires no custom palette and will look best with vanilla palettes 3, 4, and 7.

UPDATE: I updated the Wham Bam Rock carvings to look more like his less-controversial Super Star Ultra design.
